name: Stripe
summary: Payments data from a Stripe account: charges, customers, payment intents, invoices, subscriptions and the balance.

api_key.description: a Stripe secret key (sk_test_/sk_live_) or, better, a restricted key (rk_live_) with read permissions only (Dashboard > Developers > API keys). Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Amounts are integers in the currency's smallest unit (cents for USD: 1099 = $10.99); timestamps are Unix seconds.
List endpoints page with cursors: pass the last object's id as starting_after (has_more says whether to continue); limit is 1-100, default 10.

Search endpoints page with the next_page value from the previous response as page, not starting_after. Search data can lag writes by up to a minute (an hour during outages) and is not available to merchants in India.
A test key (sk_test_) only sees sandbox data; live data needs a live or restricted key. Prefer a read-only restricted key for this catalog.
Responses follow the account's API version unless a Stripe-Version header is sent; field shapes can differ between versions.
Refunds, payouts, customer updates and other writes are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get account balance
endpoints.summary: Available and pending funds per currency.

endpoints.name: List balance transactions
endpoints.summary: Every movement of funds (charges, refunds, fees, payouts), newest first.

created_gte.description: Only transactions created at or after this Unix time.

created_lt.description: Only transactions created before this Unix time.

payout.description: Only transactions paid out in this payout id.

source.description: Only transactions for this source object id (a charge, say).

type.description: Only transactions of this type, e.g. charge, refund, payout.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last object on the previous page.

ending_before.description: Cursor: the id of the first object on the next page, to page backwards.

endpoints.name: List charges
endpoints.summary: Charges, newest first, optionally for one customer or payment intent.

customer.description: Only charges for this customer id (cus_...).

payment_intent.description: Only charges created by this PaymentIntent id (pi_...).

transfer_group.description: Only charges for this transfer group.

created_gte.description: Only charges created at or after this Unix time.

created_lt.description: Only charges created before this Unix time.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last object on the previous page.

ending_before.description: Cursor: the id of the first object on the next page, to page backwards.

notes: An unknown customer id is an error, not an empty list.

endpoints.name: Search charges
endpoints.summary: Charges matching a Stripe Search Query Language expression.

query.description: A Search Query Language expression over the charge query fields (docs.stripe.com/search).

page.description: The next_page value from the previous response; leave out on the first call.

endpoints.name: List customers
endpoints.summary: Customers, newest first, optionally by exact email.

email.description: Exact, case-sensitive email to filter by.

created_gte.description: Only customers created at or after this Unix time.

created_lt.description: Only customers created before this Unix time.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last object on the previous page.

ending_before.description: Cursor: the id of the first object on the next page, to page backwards.

endpoints.name: Get a customer
notes: A deleted customer comes back with deleted: true and few other fields.

endpoints.name: Search customers
endpoints.summary: Customers matching a Search Query Language expression (name, email, metadata, ...).

query.description: A Search Query Language expression over the customer query fields.

page.description: The next_page value from the previous response; leave out on the first call.

endpoints.name: List payment intents
endpoints.summary: PaymentIntents, newest first, optionally for one customer.

customer.description: Only payment intents for this customer id.

created_gte.description: Only payment intents created at or after this Unix time.

created_lt.description: Only payment intents created before this Unix time.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last object on the previous page.

ending_before.description: Cursor: the id of the first object on the next page, to page backwards.

endpoints.name: List invoices
endpoints.summary: Invoices, newest first, by customer, subscription or status.

customer.description: Only invoices for this customer id.

subscription.description: Only invoices for this subscription id.

created_gte.description: Only invoices created at or after this Unix time.

created_lt.description: Only invoices created before this Unix time.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last object on the previous page.

ending_before.description: Cursor: the id of the first object on the next page, to page backwards.

endpoints.name: List subscriptions
endpoints.summary: Subscriptions by customer, price or status.

customer.description: Only subscriptions for this customer id.

price.description: Only subscriptions that contain this price id.

status.description: Unset returns every subscription that is not canceled; all returns every status; ended returns canceled and incomplete_expired ones.

created_gte.description: Only subscriptions created at or after this Unix time.

created_lt.description: Only subscriptions created before this Unix time.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last object on the previous page.

ending_before.description: Cursor: the id of the first object on the next page, to page backwards.
